python3 << 'EOF'
# Japanese Yen: -74 billion JPY at 114 JPY per USD
jpy_net_options_billions = -74  # billions of JPY
jpy_exchange_rate = 114  # JPY per USD

# Convert to millions of USD
# -74 billion JPY = -74,000 million JPY
# -74,000 / 114 = millions of USD
jpy_in_millions_usd = (jpy_net_options_billions * 1000) / jpy_exchange_rate

# British Pound: 369 million GBP at 1.41 USD per GBP

gbp_exchange_rate = 1.41  # USD per GBP

# Convert to millions of USD
# 369 * 1.41 = millions of USD
gbp_in_millions_usd = gbp_net_options_millions * gbp_exchange_rate

# Calculate absolute difference
absolute_difference = abs(jpy_in_millions_usd - gbp_in_millions_usd)

print(f"JPY net options in millions of USD: {jpy_in_millions_usd:.4f}")
print(f"GBP net options in millions of USD: {gbp_in_millions_usd:.4f}")
print(f"Absolute difference: {absolute_difference:.2f} million USD")
EOF
